atoms.text: American football is the most popular sport at American high schools. Most of the high schools in the USA have an American football team. They regularly have games against each other. Mainly, it is played by boys and just a fraction of the American football players are girls.

atoms.a: The cheerleading teams cheer for their American football team.
The players wear jerseys and protective equipment.
Marching bands sometimes perform during the half-time of an American football game.
Often almost the whole school watches the matches of their team.

atoms.text: The risk of injuries is relatively high in American football because it is a contact sport. Even the sportswear, which includes a helmet, a mouthguard, shoulder, knee and thigh pads and gloves, doesn't protect them entirely from injuries. That's why injuries, for instance concussions and fractures, are rather common in American football.
